title: Scholars' Avenue
text:
Scholars' Avenue is the east-west avenue starting from the Institute Main Gate and stretching west towards Technology Students' Gymkhana ending at the joint with Nalini Ranjan Sarkar Avenue and the road towards Tech Market. The road is covered on both sides by big dense trees which provide shade to students in summer days.
